skill.celestialarts.sword_qi_slash.desc: Swing and release a crescent of sword qi that pierces several targets. Three casts in a row form a combo; the last is a heavier vertical cut that grants Sword Intent.
skill.celestialarts.flame_claw.desc: Three rapid claw strikes of spirit fire sweep a 7-block cone in front of you, leaving enemies burning.
skill.celestialarts.ice_arrows.desc: Condense five icicles and fire them in a fan. Chilled targets slow down; the third hit freezes them solid.
skill.celestialarts.lightning_step.desc: Become a bolt of lightning and blink forward, shocking everything on the path.
skill.celestialarts.wind_blade_dance.des: Three wind blades whirl around you for 8 seconds, slicing anything close and quickening your steps.
skill.celestialarts.tortoise_shield.desc: Summon a hexagonal energy shell that absorbs damage for 12 seconds and reflects part of melee blows.
skill.celestialarts.earth_shatter.desc: Slam the ground; a fissure races forward and a line of stone spikes erupts, launching enemies skyward.
skill.celestialarts.fire_lotus.desc: Gather heavenly flames into a lotus in your palm and hurl it. It detonates into a fire pillar and a burning shockwave.
skill.celestialarts.taiji_formation.desc: Inscribe a rotating Taiji array on the ground. Each pulse mends allies and suppresses and harms enemies inside.
skill.celestialarts.sword_flight.desc: Summon a spirit sword underfoot and ride it through the sky. Drains Qi continuously; press again or sneak to land.
skill.celestialarts.frozen_domain.desc: Slam a palm down; frost spreads, ice spikes burst up and a crystal dome seals the area. Enemies inside are frozen, then shattered.
skill.celestialarts.thousand_swords.desc: Stand still while 72 spirit swords condense into six wide, towering rows behind your back, tips forward; then they shoot ahead in a stream, hunting everything before you.
Channel a beam of purple divine thunder from your palms for up to 4 seconds. Drains Qi while held.
skill.celestialarts.devouring_vortex.des: Open a devouring vortex ahead that drags enemies in and drains their vitality to restore your health and Qi.
skill.celestialarts.nine_tribulations.de: Call a tribulation cloud over the target area. Nine bolts of heavenly lightning fall in sequence; the ninth is the largest.
item.celestialarts.scroll_heaven_sword: Manual: Sword From Beyond the Heavens
skill.celestialarts.heaven_sword.desc: The ultimate art. A colossal sword materialises high in the sky and plunges to the ground, devastating everything near the impact.
item.celestialarts.scroll_heaven_hand: Manual: Hand of the Heavenly Dao
skill.celestialarts.heaven_hand.desc: The super-ultimate art. Borrow the will of the Heavenly Dao for 16 seconds: an eight-trigram formation opens in the sky, a 110-block palm slowly descends and suppresses every living thing within 220 blocks – no jumping, no flying, slowly crushed – then slams down with a devastating blow and a shockwave that races to the edge of the domain. The caster is rooted and nearly invulnerable while channelling.
skill.celestialarts.vajra_palm.desc: A golden seal flashes before your palm and everything in front of you is hurled away. Foes smashed into a wall take extra damage.
skill.celestialarts.wind_dragon.desc: Summon a wind dragon that rolls forward as a tornado, dragging enemies in and lifting them before bursting apart.
skill.celestialarts.golden_body.desc: Your body turns to burnished gold for ten seconds: half of every blow is shrugged off and reflected, fire cannot touch you and your strikes hit harder.
skill.celestialarts.thunder_dragon.desc: Gather heavenly thunder, then release a serpent of purple lightning that hunts enemies, pierces through them and detonates.

talent.celestialarts.mortal_body.desc: An ordinary body with nothing special about it.
talent.celestialarts.iron_bone.desc: Bones hard as iron: +2 armor, +10% health.
talent.celestialarts.swift_wind.desc: A light frame: +10% speed, wind arts +10%.
talent.celestialarts.sword_bone.desc: Meridians shaped like a blade: sword arts +15%.
talent.celestialarts.flame_heart.desc: A heart of red fire: fire arts +15%, immune to fire.
talent.celestialarts.frost_marrow.desc: Marrow of ice: ice arts +15%, can never be frozen.
talent.celestialarts.thunder_body.desc: A body in tune with thunder: lightning arts +15%, tribulation lightning −35%.
talent.celestialarts.earth_spirit.desc: Dense as the earth: earth arts +15%, +2 armor, +20% knockback resistance.
talent.celestialarts.dao_heart.desc: A Dao heart firm as a mountain: +15% breakthrough chance, qi deviation lasts half as long.
Meridians open from birth: +25% max qi, +30% qi regeneration.
talent.celestialarts.void_spirit.desc: A body in tune with the void: void arts +20%, all cooldowns −10%.
A saint body of old: +30% health, +2 attack, all arts +15%.
talent.celestialarts.chaos_body.desc: A once-in-ten-thousand-years physique: every element +12%, but the heaviest tribulations under heaven.
Meridians damaged from birth: −30% qi regeneration, −20% cultivation gain.
